Why it matters

A world built to make you dangerous — in a good way

You don't read about data breaches here — you hear the granary bell ring at midnight and race to contain one. You don't memorize "data minimization" — you stop an overloaded merchant's cart at the gate and decide what he really needs.

Progress like any adventurer: take on quests, solve puzzles, beat the clock, defeat the monsters. Earn renown, swap tips in the square, and join a growing community of privacy folk, security folk, and the AI-curious — Privacy Village is also a creative haven of music, comics, and hackathons, which is why Forbes came looking, and why villagers call it the Disneyland of Privacy.

“Learning that feels like an adventure, because it is one.”

Take quests from the village folk — the watchman, the baker, the healer, the herald — each hiding a real privacy or security skill inside a small story.

Study in the Academy halls at your own pace, then put the lesson to work on a real villager's problem.

Earn renown, not just points — badges you'd actually want to flex in the village square.

A creative haven, not just a course — music, comics, hackathons, and the festival Forbes came looking for.

A new arc begins

The Battle for AI has begun

A new force has entered the realm: machines that speak, decide, and act — marvels and menaces both. Some say AI will till every field and answer every riddle. Others whisper of golems that act before anyone grants them leave.

In Privacy Village, you'll learn what these powers can do, where the danger hides, and how a wise villager puts guardrails around a golem before handing it the keys to the granary.

The realm doesn't need spectators. It needs defenders who understand the magic.

Join the Battle

The legend

The Legend of Privacy Village

For four winters, privacy professionals gathered each January in a virtual village to celebrate Data Privacy Day — with games, competitions, and creativity. Then the festival ended, the gates closed, and the village fell quiet until the next one.

No longer.

The village is waking up for good — a persistent world you can visit any day of the year to solve quests, study in the Academy, and sharpen the skills the age of AI demands. The festival still returns every January, grander than ever. But now, the village never sleeps.

MB
Mert Can Boyar
Village Founder

I'm a privacy lawyer by trade and a privacy engineer by heart. I've spent years teaching this field through games, music, and stories — from directing a university privacy innovation lab to writing guides for privacy engineers — because the people protecting our data deserve better than boring training. Privacy Village is that belief, built into a world. Come help me expand the map.

Every January

The village throws the greatest festival in the realm

The Data Privacy Day Festival is where it all began — competitions, hackathons, live performances, games, and gatherings that turn the world's privacy professionals into one loud, joyful village square.

The next festival arrives on January 28 — and this time, when the music fades, the village stays open.

The quest board

Eight quests await. More are being forged.

Privacy threat modeling

The Siege Map

The watchman fears raiders. Walk the walls with him and map every way an attacker could get in — before one does.

Data flow diagrams

Rivers of the Realm

Grain flows from field to mill to market. So does data. Trace where it travels, who touches it, and where it leaks.

Data minimization

The Overladen Cart

A merchant arrives collecting far more than he needs. Stop him at the gate and teach him to travel light.

Purpose limitation

The Baker's Oath

Flour given for bread must become bread. Help the baker keep his promise — and learn why data given for one purpose must stay true to it.

De-identification

The Masquerade

Tonight, every villager wears a mask. Your task: make sure no one can be unmasked — no matter how cleverly the clues are combined.

Breach notification

Ring the Bell

The granary has been breached at midnight. The bell must ring, the right people must know, and the clock is already running.

Technical & organizational measures

Walls and Wards

Stone walls, iron locks, sworn oaths, night patrols. Learn which defenses are built and which are promised — and why a village needs both.

Sensitive data

The Healer's Ledger

The healer's hut holds the village's most delicate secrets. Guard them with the extra care the law — and decency — demand.

Rumors from the forge

The Cloakmaker's Guild (privacy-enhancing technologies) and The Common Tongue (usable privacy) are being crafted as we speak.

About

About Privacy Village

Privacy Village is built by Imagine Privacy — the studio behind PrivacyQuest, a growing set of gamified tools for teaching privacy, AI safety, and compliance. What began as a Unity-built compliance simulator has grown into this persistent village, its Academy, and its yearly festival.

The project is led by Mert Can Boyar — a privacy lawyer by trade, a privacy engineer by heart, and someone who'd rather teach through play than PowerPoint.
